title: Chapter 531
text:
The Colton Star Cluster contained many Star Systems, and Godora occupied the Garton Star System. From the star map, the Garton Star System was located to the southwest of the Colton Star Cluster and was connected to three other Star Systems. There was the Fey Star System controlled by Holy Stone and Black Crow, the Skywalker Star System controlled by Hutt Ming, and the Hyde Star System that was not controlled by any powerful Star System. Tsinghua Book Network

The Hyde Star System was a land of contention, and there had never been any high-level Star System Level Ming there. Its level of development was far lower than the regions controlled by the Star System Level Ming, and it was rich in resources. Be it mineral planets or energy planets, they could be mined for tens of millions of years.

The geographical location of Hyde was rather unique, and it was connected to the territories of six high-level Stars. In the eyes of these high-level Stars, Hyde was undoubtedly a piece of juicy meat. Be it for the sake of resources or strategic value, this region was a place that had to be fought over. The six high-level Stars expanded one after another, and each of them occupied a portion of Hyde.

Hyde was not under the jurisdiction of any Star System Level Ming, and the six Star System Level Ming treated the regions that they had already occupied as' new territories'. However, due to the disputes over the ownership of the territories, the six Star System Level Ming coveted one another, resulting in constant conflicts. The Hyde Star System Level Ming had always been the main diplomatic point of the six Star System Level Ming, and none of them were willing to give in.

Of the six Star System Level Ming that had divided Hyde, there were Godora and Hutt Ming. As their territories were connected to each other, the conflicts were even more intense.

While the Mutation Disaster in the Garton Star System was causing a commotion, Hutt Ming's Skywalker Star System welcomed a special guest.

On a certain desolate and uninhabited planet, a small spaceship was parked on a black plain. The door of the spaceship opened, and the leader of Dark-star squatted on the ground, using his finger to casually draw on the ground, waiting for the person that he had contacted.

Xiu!

Soon, a loud noise came from the sky, and a spaceship with the Hutt logo slowly landed not far away. A Hutt in a high-level uniform walked down the stairs, followed by dozens of guards. He seemed to be a very important person.

The leader of Dark-star raised his head and looked up. There were dozens of bright spots floating in the dark sky, and they were all the guards of the person that had come, waiting for orders outside the atmosphere. The Hutt in front of him was a high-ranking official. He was the emissary sent to communicate with him. The leader of Dark-star had secretly contacted Hutt and facilitated this meeting.

Official Hutt waved his hand and signaled for the guards to retreat. He walked forward alone and sized up the Dark-star leader. "You have guts, daring to step into the Skywalker Star System with only a few people. Are you not afraid that we will capture you and send you to Godora?"

Dark-star's leader was fearless. "I came here alone to show my sincerity. Furthermore, you won't do anything to me. Dark-star's existence can restrict Godora. An enemy's enemy is a friend … Alright, I know that Dark-star's reputation is terrible, and Hurt is unwilling to have anything to do with us. However, no one will go against benefits."

"Heh, confident people will always die because of their own self-confidence." The official from Hutt was expressionless.

"Since you are willing to meet me, it means that you are interested in what I have to say. Then, I will make it short. The commotion caused by us has affected Godora's energy, and now is the best time to encroach on Godora's territory in Hyde. As long as it does not escalate into an all-out war between the two Supers, the peace treaty can go to hell …"

"You want to use us to pressure Godora and help you indirectly? Humph, you think too highly of your conditions. Starting a war with Godora for that bit of territory is too risky. The Star Cluster Supers in the Shattered Star Ring will not allow us to break the rules. If we attract the attention of the three Supers, it will be even worse … The era of war is long over, and it is not so easy now, "the official from Hutt said coldly.

"Supers who do not maintain their ambitions have no future." The Dark-star leader said coldly, "The structure of the galaxy has been set long ago. If you do not think of a way to move forward, you will forever be a plaything at the top of the food chain. Everyone has hidden their fangs, but no one has truly accepted their fate. The path forward will only get more and more crowded, and competition is unavoidable. However, the current order ensures that the losers will not lose everything.

Every minute, there are hundreds and thousands of places in the entire universe where wars break out. You know better than I do that war to a certain extent is tacitly allowed. Only idiots would think that a single 'peace treaty' would be able to erase all disputes. Everyone chooses to abide by this rule. Other than submitting to the military might of the Three Great Ming, this rule is also to ensure the safety of the losers. As long as the Ming's strength reaches the standard to enter the game, they will not be exterminated, which is beneficial to everyone. "

The official from Hutt did not say anything. This was indeed a hidden consensus. As long as intelligent species did not go extinct, wars would never disappear. The only thing that changed was the way they fought. Life and thought had infinite possibilities. Since it was' infinite ', it meant that the complete peace where all species understood each other would never come.

The 'peace treaty' created by the three Supers covered all Supers on paper, but when it was actually implemented, there would naturally be more hidden rules. Only Supers who had reached the Star System level would be able to obtain this' exemption from death '. The universe was vast, and there were many species dying and being born every minute. Only Supers who had a certain level of strength or status would have the right to be valued. Being at the Star System level was the prerequisite for entering the game.

Hutt and Godora were both at this level. There were constant conflicts, but they had a tacit understanding of each other and controlled the conflicts to a certain extent. They knew that they could not do anything to each other, so they placed more importance on fighting for benefits. This was like knowing that there was a competitor and that they could not kill him, so they could only snatch the benefits … The official from Hutt was actually interested in the suggestion of the Dark-star leader.

After a moment of silence, the official from Hutt slowly opened his mouth and asked a question that made the Dark-star leader's expression change.

"The goal of Dark-star is to overthrow the rule of the purebloods and establish a new Godora. However, your destruction of Godora has already exceeded the bottom line, and you have been classified as a terrorist organization. Do you think you still have any chance of becoming the ruler? The only way for you is a coup d 'état. However, let's not talk about the slim chance of success. As long as there is a Dark-star leader, the Star Cluster Supers will immediately punish you. Do you really think that ruling over Godora can wash away your past crimes? No, unless you can stand shoulder to shoulder with the Star Cluster Supers overnight, there will be a day of reckoning!

I am really fine. What are you Dark-star thinking? "

"…" The Dark-star leader lowered his eyes and said with a strange tone, "This has nothing to do with you."

…

According to the prosperity of the planet, the planets controlled by Godora could be categorized into different grades. The mother planet and a few other planets were classified as first-tier planets, and below that were first-tier planets. Planet Golden Gate, which was close to Juberly Hub, was an example. The second-tier planets, which were slightly worse, were third-tier planets.

Garton Star System, a certain second-tier colonial planet of Godora.

An old looking spaceship landed, and it was extremely inconspicuous in the bustling docks.

Ashes, who was wearing a disguise, walked down from the spaceship and looked at the crowd and the guards not far away. The crowd flowed endlessly, and it was a scene of prosperity.

A cold smile appeared on his face, and he slowly raised his hand to the same height as his eyes. He then snapped his fingers.

"Turn into dust."

His voice was transmitted to the fleet that was on standby far away from the colonial planet through a miniature communicator. There were a total of three Dark-star motherships that were ready to make a move.
